description: Committed mirror of the Rust parser error/warning code taxonomy (crates/fvf-wasm/src/error.rs). The Rust taxonomy test (tests/error_taxonomy.rs) and the TS wasm32 conformance suite (apps/web/src/conformance/wasm32-conformance.test.ts) both assert exact agreement with this file, keeping the TypeScript error-code unions in sync with Rust without hand-maintained duplication.
